description: This file defines a custom view class 'NoteCardView' that extends MaterialCardView. It overrides touch event handling to intercept all touch events, likely to prevent interaction with the card.

classes.name: NoteCardView
classes.description: A custom view extending MaterialCardView, overriding touch event interception.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides the default method to intercept all touch events, returning true to consume them and prevent further propagation.
